**Feature Category**:
- [ ] New film simulation preset (e.g., Fujifilm Classic Chrome/Neg, Kodak Gold, Leica Monochrome)
- [ ] Additional Sony mirrorless/compact camera model support
- [ ] Build/installation tooling improvement
- [ ] Other enhancement

**Detailed Description**:
Describe the requested feature or film preset and its use case.

**Reference Data / Cube LUT**:
If you have a `.cube` 3D LUT, Gamma curve, or RGB matrix data, feel free to share it here.
